scope: Proposition 6.5 (Lower bound for the best constant) of the manuscript “Diagonal Fourier extension for positively curved surfaces in three dimensions” (preprints/Diagonal-Fourier-extension-for-positively-curved-surfaces-in-three-dimensions-September-24-2026/Diagonal-Fourier-extension-for-positively-curved-surfaces-in-three-dimensions-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 077 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 098a6acc53131ae5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every nonempty compact smooth surface Σ in the stated class there is cΣ > 0 such that its best extension constant satisfies Cbest Σ,p ≥ cΣ(p − 3)−1/p , 3 < p ≤ 4. (6.13) This conclusion does not use the Kakeya or packet estimates.
